description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info. It also integrates Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Defines REST endpoints for greeting, documentation, health, and info; annotated as a Spring Boot REST controller with Swagger documentation tags.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI based on incoming request headers.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application information.
